title: D/V/D-Redacted
overview: Unearthed from a landfill, a YouTuber discovers a sealed envelope marked "CONFIDENTIAL" - inside are four unmarked DVDs. Each disc reveals terrifying footage that was never meant to be seen. What he uncovers exposes a government cover-up too horrifying to ignore.
